comment: Per-resort corrections applied by pipeline/normalize_osm.py (ADR-036). See whistler-blackcomb.overrides.json for the format. One polygon, way/1388616336 (Kimberley Alpine Resort): the resort's four mountain faces, Northstar Mountain, Tamarack Ridge, Vimy Ridge and Black Forest, on one ticket and one map; no other ski area lies in the box or the Overpass window (the Kimberley Nordic Club's race loops at the base are left out by the type rule). Every named run and lift checked on 2026-11-10 against Kimberley's current trail map (skikimberley.com/discover-kimberley/resort-map, Kimberley-Trail-Map-23-inside-production.pdf, made 2023-06-13, the map the resort's page links), rendered at 50 to 600 dpi and read tile by tile: its lists number and rate 79 runs face by face, and its lift table names the five lifts, as the resort's mountain stats page does (skikimberley.com/discover-kimberley/mountain-stats: North Star Express, Easter triple, Tamarack double, Owl T-bar and Owlette carpet). The resort's terrain status loads by script, so the printed map is the only source. The map's legend has four grades: Easiest (green circle), More Difficult (blue square), Most Difficult (one black diamond) and Extreme (two, the North American double black: Jack the Bear, White Pine and Robinson's Ridge, none of them in OSM); OSM's easy, intermediate, advanced and expert match them. Two runs carry a split symbol: Main, a green circle behind a blue square, and Anton's, a blue square behind a diamond; OSM rates their pieces so already. Of OSM's 62 named runs, every one carries the map's rating: no rating override. Buckhorn (8), blue on the list, ends on the map at Bradford BLVD's road, below which the map draws only Blueberry's black line (10) to Ridgeway; OSM's last 333 m of Buckhorn, beside Blueberry below that road, is advanced, as the map's line there, and stays. Names from the map: Bradford BLVD (OSM Bradford BVLD). Names that differ from the map only by punctuation stay as OSM has them (Notre-Dame for NOTRE DAME); Midget, OSM's 551 m blue line from the Tamarack chair's top towards Caper, is not on the map's lists (it may be the map's Midwinder, 23, blue, beside the Northstar and Tamarack Ridge boundary) and stays as OSM names it. Lift names that differ from the map's table only by the lift's kind stay as OSM has them (Easter for the Easter Triple Chair, Tamarack for the Tamarack Double Chair, North Star Express for the North Star Quad); all five lifts are in OSM, none hidden. Parks: the map marks no named terrain park; its legend's RCR Rail Park symbol stands on Main beside the North Star Express, on no run of its own, and OSM maps no park, so nothing gets the park flag (an OSM gap). OSM gaps (shipped as at Palisades Tahoe): Canada Way, Jack the Bear, White Pine, Robinson's Ridge and Waldie's Trail (the map's easy way down) on Northstar Mountain; Runt Glades, Copping's Corner, Copping's Glades, Pyx, Pyx Glades and Shooter on Tamarack Ridge; All Over Glades on Vimy Ridge; Dean Glades, Twixt Glades, Angus Glades, Ruff and Geneva Glades in the Black Forest; and Midwinder unless it is OSM's Midget. NEIGHBOURS: none.

overrides.reason: Kimberley's current trail map (skikimberley.com/discover-kimberley/resort-map, Kimberley-Trail-Map-23-inside-production.pdf, made 2023-06-13, the map the resort's page links) lists run 13 on Northstar Mountain, green (Easiest) as OSM rates it, as BRADFORD BLVD; OSM spells it Bradford BVLD.
